We need to propose a retrosynthesis route with 3 reactions for target SMILES: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1

Let's parse: It's a tolyl (para methyl phenyl) attached to sulfonamide linking to another phenyl with a trans-α,β-unsaturated amide attached to an aniline.

Structure: p-methyl phenyl -NH- SO2 - phenyl -CH=CH- C(=O)-NH- phenyl -NH2? Actually Nc3ccccc3N indicates an aniline (para? not specified). So amide attached to aniline.

We need 3 steps retrosynthesis: likely disconnections:

1) Amide formation: break C(=O)N bond between carbonyl carbon (from α,β-unsaturated acid) and aniline nitrogen. So precursor: α,β-unsaturated carboxylic acid (C= C- C(=O)OH) attached to phenyl (the same phenyl) and aniline as separate.

2) Doebner modification to form α,β-unsaturated acid from aromatic aldehyde and malonic acid. So break C=C double bond formation: precursor aromatic aldehyde (maybe c2ccc(CHO)cc2) and malonic acid.

3) Sulfonamide formation: break S-N bond between sulfonyl chloride and aniline (the tolyl amine). So precursor: tolyl amine (p-methyl aniline) and sulfonyl chloride (ClSO2- phenyl). Actually sulfonyl chloride attached to phenyl (c2ccc... )? The sulfonyl group attached to second phenyl. So sulfonyl chloride derived from that phenyl (aryl sulfonyl chloride). So break S-N bond: precursor sulfonyl chloride (aryl sulfonyl chloride) and aniline (p-methyl aniline).

Thus three steps: (i) amide coupling, (ii) Doebner modification to make α,β-unsaturated acid, (iii) sulfonamide formation.

We need to provide JSON route with reactions and template IDs. We need template IDs; we can search for templates matching each transformation.

First, amide formation: functional_groups_broken: aliphatic carboxylic acid? Actually forward reaction: carboxylic acid + amine -> amide (break C-O bond). So in retrosynthesis we break amide to give acid and amine. So we need template where functional_groups_broken includes "aliphatic carboxylic acid" and formed "amide". But earlier search gave error because we used "carboxylic_acid". The correct functional group is "aliphatic carboxylic acid". Let's search.
